description:
Full Stack Developer (Angular + Java) 
 Are you a highly motivated, creative individual and passionate about sales and proposals? 
 Would you like to be a part of successful team? 

 Join our team! 
 Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward! Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet. 
 As a Full Stack Developer for Baker Hughes , you will be responsible for building and enhancing modern full-stack web applications. This role requires strong hands-on experience in Angular-based frontend development, along with backend development experience using Node.js and/or Java Spring Boot.

 This is a hands-on individual contributor role, working closely with product, QA, architecture, platform and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable and maintainable digital solutions. The role also requires openness to using AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, code quality and delivery speed.
 Building modern, responsive and maintainable web applications using Angular, TypeScript and JavaScript
 Developing backend services using Java Spring Boot
 Designing, consuming and integrating REST APIs to support full-stack application workflows
 Owning end-to-end feature development across frontend, backend, testing and deployment support
 Using AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity, code quality, debugging, testing or documentation
 Applying clean code practices, frontend/backend architecture, reusable components and design pattern principles
 Building performant, scalable and maintainable solutions aligned to technical standards and architecture guidelines
 Working with AWS cloud infrastructure or similar cloud platforms and cloud-native concepts
 Supporting CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab or Azure DevOps
 Writing unit tests and supporting code quality practices using tools such as SonarQube or equivalent
 Following secure coding practices and supporting remediation of findings from SAST, DAST, OSS scans or vulnerability assessments
 Working in Agile/Scrum teams with strong collaboration across product, QA, platform and business stakeholders
 Nice to have: Python knowledge and experience supporting automation, scripting or data-related use cases
  
 Fuel your passion! 
 To be successful in this role you will have:
 At-least 5+ years hands-on software development experience  
 Strong Angular experience (recent Angular versions preferred)
 Backend experience in Java Spring Boot  
 Good to have a strong TypeScript / JavaScript experience 
 Experience with REST APIs / backend integration  
 Exposure to AWS  
 Should have worked on full-stack development  (Frontend plus backend/API work)
 Experience with CI/CD tools ( GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps )
 Has worked on end-to-end feature development  (from requirement to development, testing, deployment or production support )
 Familiarity with unit testing / code quality practices  (Jasmine, Jest, ViTest, Karma, JUnit, SonarQube, code reviews )
 Awareness of secure coding / security scans  (SAST, DAST, OSS scans, vulnerability fixes)
 Uses AI tools for development productivity  (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Cline, OpenCode, Claude Code or similar)
 Comfortable using AI tools for coding, debugging, unit test generation, refactoring or documentation 
  
 Work in a way that works for you 
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. 
 Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
  
 Working with us 
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
 Working for you 
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
  
 Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
 Comprehensive private medical care options
 Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
 Tailored financial programs
 Additional elected or voluntary benefits
  
 
 
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Specialist - Software Engineering
